description: Every port whose own published list of vessel arrivals and departures GADUIN reads, by UN/LOCODE, with its name, country, coordinates, time zone, when its list was last read and found up to date, and whether that is current (within current_within_minutes). Only these ports have a board (get_port_board) or appear in vessel port calls (get_vessel_port_calls); a port missing here is one GADUIN does not read, not one without traffic. The list is never cut.
name: list_ports
title: Ports with a movement list
